module

public import FormalConjecturesUtil

/-!
# Convergence of fraction numerators $a(n)/b(n)$ to $e$

a: Numerators of a sequence of fractions converging to $e$.
$$a(1) = 3, a(2) = 5$$
For $n > 2$:
$$a(n) = \begin{cases} \left(\frac{n+2}{2}\right) a(n-1) - a(n-2) -
\left(\frac{n-2}{2}\right) a(n-3)
& \text{if } n \text{ is even} \cr 2 a(n-1) + n a(n-2) & \text{if } n \text{ is odd} \end{cases}$$

*References:*
- [A340737](https://oeis.org/A340737)
- [arxiv/2605.22763](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.22763) *Advancing Mathematics Research with AI-Driven Formal Proof Search* by George Tsoukalas et al.
- [b](https://oeis.org/b)
-/

@[expose] public section

namespace OeisA340737


open MeasureTheory

open scoped Real

open Nat

/--
Numerators of a sequence of fractions converging to $e$.
$$a(1) = 3, a(2) = 5$$
For $n > 2$:
$$a(n) = \begin{cases} \left(\frac{n+2}{2}\right) a(n-1) - a(n-2) -
\left(\frac{n-2}{2}\right) a(n-3)
& \text{if } n \text{ is even} \cr 2 a(n-1) + n a(n-2) & \text{if } n \text{ is odd} \end{cases}$$
-/
def a (n : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  match n with
  | 0 => 0 -- Required for total function, O(1,1) suggests 0 is not relevant.
  | 1 => 3
  | 2 => 5
  | n' + 3 => -- n $\ge$ 3
    let n := n' + 3

    let a_nm1 := a (n - 1)
    let a_nm2 := a (n - 2)
    let a_nm3 := a (n - 3)

    if n % 2 = 0 then
      -- n is even, n $\ge$ 4
      let c1 : ℕ := (n + 2) / 2
      let c2 : ℕ := (n - 2) / 2

      -- $a(n) = c_1 \cdot a(n-1) - a(n-2) - c_2 \cdot a(n-3)$.
      -- We use Int.ofNat for safe subtraction, as the result is known to be positive.
      Int.toNat (Int.ofNat c1 * Int.ofNat a_nm1 - Int.ofNat a_nm2 - Int.ofNat c2 * Int.ofNat a_nm3)
    else
      -- n is odd, n $\ge$ 3
      2 * a_nm1 + n * a_nm2
termination_by n

/--
Denominators of a sequence of fractions converging to $e$.
This sequence is defined by the same recurrence relation as a but with
initial values $b(1)=1, b(2)=2$.
$$b(1) = 1, b(2) = 2$$
For $n > 2$:
$$b(n) = \begin{cases} \left(\frac{n+2}{2}\right) b(n-1) - b(n-2) -
\left(\frac{n-2}{2}\right) b(n-3)
& \text{if } n \text{ is even} \cr 2 b(n-1) + n b(n-2) & \text{if } n \text{ is odd} \end{cases}$$
-/
def b (n : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  match n with
  | 0 => 0
  | 1 => 1
  | 2 => 2
  | n' + 3 => -- n $\ge$ 3
    let n := n' + 3

    let b_nm1 := b (n - 1)
    let b_nm2 := b (n - 2)
    let b_nm3 := b (n - 3)

    if n % 2 = 0 then
      -- n is even, n $\ge$ 4
      let c1 : ℕ := (n + 2) / 2
      let c2 : ℕ := (n - 2) / 2

      -- $b(n) = c_1 \cdot b(n-1) - b(n-2) - c_2 \cdot b(n-3)$.
      -- We use Int.ofNat for safe subtraction.
      Int.toNat (Int.ofNat c1 * Int.ofNat b_nm1 - Int.ofNat b_nm2 - Int.ofNat c2 * Int.ofNat b_nm3)
    else
      -- n is odd, n $\ge$ 3
      2 * b_nm1 + n * b_nm2
termination_by n


@[category test, AMS 11]
lemma a_1 : a 1 = 3 := by unfold a; rfl

@[category test, AMS 11]
lemma a_2 : a 2 = 5 := by unfold a; rfl

@[category test, AMS 11]
lemma a_3 : a 3 = 19 := by unfold a; unfold a; unfold a; simp

@[category test, AMS 11]
lemma a_4 : a 4 = 49 := by unfold a; unfold a; unfold a; unfold a; simp

@[category test, AMS 11]
lemma a_5 : a 5 = 193 := by unfold a; unfold a; unfold a; unfold a; unfold a; simp


/--
Conjecture: $\lim_{n \to \infty} a(n) / b(n) = e$, where $b(n)$ is the companion denominator sequence.

A formal proof has been found with the methods described in
[arxiv/2605.22763](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.22763).
-/
@[category research solved, AMS 11, formal_proof using formal_conjectures at
"https://github.com/mo271/formal-conjectures/blob/a32396489dcb8f86c3549b93aa358ac6a10a3a1f/FormalConjectures/OEIS/340737.wip.lean#L438"]
theorem tendsto_exp_one :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (a n : ℝ) / (b n : ℝ)) Filter.atTop (nhds (Real.exp 1)) := by
    sorry

end OeisA340737

findings.description: The module's companion-sequence reference (line 33) is `[b](https://oeis.org/b)`. The intended OEIS entry is A340738, whose initial values and recurrence match `OeisA340737.b`. This is a reference slip, not a mathematical error.
findings.source_evidence: OEIS A340737 explicitly says "Denominators are listed in A340738." A340738 gives initial values 1, 2 and the same recurrence used by `b`. Read via https://raw.githubusercontent.com/oeis/oeisdata/main/seq/A340/A340737.seq and https://raw.githubusercontent.com/oeis/oeisdata/main/seq/A340/A340738.seq.

reformulations.difference: OEIS starts both sequences at index 1. Lean extends them by `a 0 = b 0 = 0`, so the real-valued ratio has the additional value 0/0 = 0 at index 0.
reformulations.equivalence_argument: No positive-indexed term depends on the added zeroth values: the n = 3 odd branch uses only indices 2 and 1, and every subsequent recursive argument is positive. Adding or changing the zeroth ratio does not affect convergence at infinity. The scratch file proves the limit statement equivalent to the statement for n ↦ a(n+1)/b(n+1), and separately proves invariance under an arbitrary replacement of the zeroth ratio.

review.notes: No mathematical misformalization found in either definition, the five test lemmas, or the convergence theorem. Computed the first fifteen terms of both sequences and matched them to OEIS. Lean checks in /workspace/review/scratch.lean prove that the even-step integer expressions are nonnegative, so Int.toNat does not truncate them; the coefficient divisions are exact; and b(n) > 0 for every n ≥ 1. The solved status agrees with OEIS's June 2026 proof comment and the cited literature. The OEIS-linked AlphaProof artifact was also compiled after import/API compatibility edits in /workspace/review/external_proof_check.lean; its sequences were proved equal to the reviewed definitions, and the resulting convergence theorem depends only on propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound. Direct OEIS pages were blocked by Cloudflare, so the official OEIS data mirror was used. The reviewed file remains identical to the specified commit.
